9-6.title: Required Surface Interval Before Ascent to Altitude After Diving

9-7.title: No-Decompression Limits and Repetitive Group Designators for No-Decompression Air Dives

9-8.title: Residual Nitrogen Time Table for Repetitive Air Dives

source.edition: Revision 7, 01 December 2016 (original issue, change 0); supersedes Revision 6 Change A. Units using a later change confirm against it.

rules.select: Enter the table at the exact or next greater depth and at the exact or next longer bottom time (para 9-6.1).
rules.ascent: 30 fsw/min from the bottom to the first stop, between stops and to the surface; 20 to 40 fsw/min acceptable (para 9-6.3). Descent not more than 75 fsw/min (para 9-6.2).
rules.pneumo: Pneumofathometer depth: add 1 fsw (0-100 fsw), 2 fsw (101-200), 4 fsw (201-300) (Table 9-1).
rules.repet_10min: Surface interval under 10 minutes: add the bottom times of the two dives and use the deeper of the two depths (para 9-9.1).
rules.rnt_exception: RNT exception rule: also work out the schedule for the sum of the bottom times at the deepest depth; the one with the lesser decompression obligation may be used (para 9-9.2).
rules.no_group: A schedule with no repetitive group: the diver must wait 18 hours before another dive (para 9-8.3, worked example).
rules.o2_15min: In-water air/oxygen decompression is strongly recommended whenever total air stop time exceeds 15 minutes and surface decompression is not available; over 90 minutes of air/O2 time in the water needs surface decompression on oxygen unless CNO permission for exceptional exposure (para 9-8.4).
rules.o2_stops: In the AIR/O2 rows, oxygen is breathed at the 30 and 20 fsw stops (bold in the manual); stop times include travel except the first air and first O2 stop.
t96_notes: Use the highest repetitive group designator obtained in the previous 24-hour period.
Table 9-6 may only be used when the maximum altitude achieved is 10,000 feet or less. For ascents above 10,000 feet, consult NAVSEA 00C for guidance.
Commercial aircraft: use a final altitude of 8,000 feet to compute the required surface interval before flying.
No surface interval is required before a commercial flight if the dive site is at 8,000 feet or higher.
Exceptional exposure: wait 48 hours before ascent.
t98_notes: ** Residual nitrogen time cannot be determined using this table (see paragraph 9-9.1 subparagraph 8).

† Read vertically downward to the 30 fsw repetitive dive depth. Use the corresponding residual nitrogen times to compute the equivalent single dive time. Decompress using the 30 fsw air decompression table.
Dives following surface intervals longer than the longest in a row are not repetitive dives: use actual bottom times.

zones.o2_recommended: In-water air/O2 decompression or SurDO2 recommended
zones.exceptional_air_o2_required: Exceptional exposure: in-water air decompression; in-water air/O2 decompression or SurDO2 required
zones.exceptional_surdo2_required: Exceptional exposure: in-water air/O2 decompression; SurDO2 required
